extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome toolbar, extensions page and store listing.

extDescription.message: Understand and pronounce selected text in webpages and PDFs.
extDescription.description: Short extension description shown on the extensions page. Chrome limits this to 132 characters.

speechNoVoice.message: Voice isn't available on this device.
speechNoVoice.description: Message shown when Listen is pressed but neither the browser's text-to-speech nor the fallback has any voice (FR-023). Listen is the name of a toolbar button. Followed by a hint that depends on the operating system.

speechNoVoiceForLanguage.message: No voice on this device speaks this language, so Clavis won't read it with the wrong accent.
speechNoVoiceForLanguage.description: Message shown when voices exist but none speak the language of the selected text (FR-024); Clavis never substitutes a mismatched voice. Followed by a Voice settings button.

speechStartFailed.message: The voice didn't start. Check your sound and speech settings, then try again.
speechStartFailed.description: Message shown when a voice was found but never produced audio (FR-023); avoids a fake playing state. No install hint: a voice exists.

speechInvalidRequest.message: Clavis can't read this text aloud. Select a shorter piece of text and try again.
speechInvalidRequest.description: Error shown when the text to speak is empty, too long or otherwise rejected before any voice is used.

speechCancelled.description: Status shown when a Listen request is replaced by a newer one or stopped before audio started.

disclosureTitle.message: Your reading stays on your device until you ask
disclosureTitle.description: Heading of the data disclosure on the onboarding page (FR-002). Approved copy; do not weaken.

disclosureSelect.message: Selecting text does nothing by itself. Clavis notices the selection on your device and shows its toolbar.
disclosureSelect.description: Disclosure bullet explaining that selecting text sends nothing anywhere (FR-017). Approved copy.

disclosureListen.message: Listen tries a matching on-device voice first, then an online voice if needed. Online voices send the selected text to their provider. Nothing is sent to Groq.
disclosureListen.description: Disclosure bullet explaining local-first voice selection, online fallback and where the text goes. Listen is the name of a toolbar button.

disclosureExplain.message: Explain sends the text you selected, up to 1,000 characters of the text around it, and your chosen language to Groq, using your own API key. Groq handles it under its own terms and privacy policy.
disclosureExplain.description: Disclosure bullet explaining exactly what the Explain action sends to Groq. Explain is the name of a toolbar button. Approved copy; a Groq privacy policy link follows it.

disclosurePrivacyLink.description: Link text placed after the Explain disclosure bullet; points to Groq's privacy policy.

disclosurePdf.message: PDFs you open are read inside your browser and never uploaded. Selected text can be sent when you ask for an explanation or use an online voice.
disclosurePdf.description: Disclosure bullet explaining how PDFs are handled locally. Approved copy.

disclosureNoServer.message: Clavis has no server of its own and collects no data about you.
disclosureNoServer.description: Disclosure bullet stating there is no developer backend and no data collection. Approved copy.

disclosureAccept.description: Button that acknowledges the data disclosure on the onboarding page.

firstSendBody.message: Send this to Groq? Clavis will send the selected text and a little of the text around it to Groq to explain it. You'll only be asked once.
firstSendBody.description: Confirmation shown inside the card the first time Explain is used if the disclosure was never acknowledged. Starts with a question that acts as its title.

firstSendConfirm.description: Button that confirms sending the selected text to Groq for the first time; matches the toolbar action.

firstSendCancel.description: Button that cancels the first-time send to Groq.

siteAccessTitle.message: Show Clavis when you select text
siteAccessTitle.description: Heading of the optional all-sites access section on the onboarding page (FR-009).

siteAccessBody.message: To show the toolbar automatically, Chrome will ask you to let Clavis read and change data on websites. Clavis uses this only to notice when you select text and to show its toolbar. It does not read pages in the background. Text leaves your device only when you ask for an explanation or use an online voice.
siteAccessBody.description: Explains why Chrome will show a permission prompt for website access. Approved copy; do not weaken.

siteAccessGrant.description: Button that starts the Chrome permission prompt for optional website access.

siteAccessSkip.message: Not now — I'll use right-click instead
siteAccessSkip.description: Button that skips website access; the user will use the right-click Explain with Clavis menu item instead.

keyStoreLocal.message: Remember on this device — Saved in Chrome's extension storage on this computer until you remove it. It is not encrypted: anyone with access to your Chrome profile could find it.
keyStoreLocal.description: Option for storing the API key persistently. Must not claim encryption (FR-071). Starts with a short option label.

keyStoreSession.message: Only for this session — Kept in memory and cleared when you close Chrome. You'll paste it again next time.
keyStoreSession.description: Option for keeping the API key only for the browser session (FR-071). Starts with a short option label.

keyWarning.message: Never paste your key into a website or share it in a chat.
keyWarning.description: Warning shown next to the API key input.

popupOpenReader.description: Popup button that opens the extension's PDF reader page in a new tab.

popupSettings.description: Popup button that opens the extension's settings page.

popupInjectButton.description: Popup button that runs Clavis once on the current web tab so the user can explain selected text there (FR-018).

popupInjectBusy.description: Popup button and status while Clavis asks the current tab to show Explain.

popupActionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the popup's main action group.

popupNoKeyNotice.message: Explain needs a Groq key. Listen and the PDF reader work without one.
popupNoKeyNotice.description: Short popup notice when no Groq key is connected; clarifies that setup is optional for listening and reading PDFs.

popupInjectHint.message: Select text on the page, then choose Explain on this page.
popupInjectHint.description: Hint under the popup's main actions for explaining selected text on the current tab.

popupInjectNoSelection.message: No text is selected on the page. Select some text and try again.
popupInjectNoSelection.description: Popup message shown when Clavis ran on the current tab but nothing usable was selected.

popupInjectRestricted.message: Clavis can't run on this kind of page. Try it on a regular website.
popupInjectRestricted.description: Popup message shown when the current tab is a browser-internal or store page where extensions are not allowed to run.

popupInjectNoAccess.message: Chrome did not give Clavis access to this tab. Close this popup, then click the Clavis icon again, or right-click the selected text and choose Explain with Clavis.
popupInjectNoAccess.description: Popup message shown when Chrome refused to let Clavis run on the current tab because the one-time tab access (activeTab) was not granted.

popupInjectFailed.message: Clavis couldn't run on this page. Reload the page and try again.
popupInjectFailed.description: Popup message shown when running Clavis on the current tab failed for any other reason.

toolbarGroupLabel.message: Clavis actions for the selected text
toolbarGroupLabel.description: Accessible name of the small toolbar that appears next to selected text on a web page.

toolbarListen.description: Toolbar button that reads the selected text aloud; called Listen in the privacy disclosure.

toolbarExplain.description: Toolbar button that explains the selected text; called Explain in the privacy disclosure.

toolbarCardPlaceholder.message: Clavis couldn't show the explanation. Press Lookup to try again.
toolbarCardPlaceholder.description: State line in the toolbar card when the Explain action finished without drawing its explanation card.

toolbarWorking.description: State line in the toolbar card while Listen or Explain is running. Also announced to screen readers.

toolbarActionFailed.message: That didn't work. Press the button to try again.
toolbarActionFailed.description: State line in the toolbar card, and screen reader announcement, when Listen or Explain failed.

toolbarTooLong.description: Heading shown in the toolbar when the selected text is longer than the limit Clavis can use at once.

toolbarTooLongHint.message: Clavis can use up to $COUNT$ characters at a time.
toolbarTooLongHint.description: Explains the Selection too long state. $COUNT$ is the limit, already formatted, for example 2,000.

toolbarTooLongLive.message: Selection too long. Choose Use the first $COUNT$ characters to continue.
toolbarTooLongLive.description: Screen reader announcement when the toolbar shows the Selection too long state. $COUNT$ is the limit, already formatted, for example 2,000.

toolbarUseFirst.description: Toolbar button for a selection that is too long: keeps only the beginning of it. $COUNT$ is the limit, already formatted, for example 2,000. Nothing is sent by pressing it.

toolbarTrimmed.description: Heading above the shortened text after the user chose to use the beginning of a long selection, and its screen reader announcement. $COUNT$ is the length of the shortened text, already formatted.

toolbarTrimmedPreview.message: The text that will be used
toolbarTrimmedPreview.description: Accessible name of the scrollable box that shows the shortened text of a long selection.

toolbarClose.description: Button that closes a short message shown by the Clavis toolbar.

toolbarNoticeFrameAccess.message: Clavis can't read text inside this embedded frame without website access. Select text outside the frame, or turn on website access for Clavis in Settings.
toolbarNoticeFrameAccess.description: Message shown on a page when the user chose Explain with Clavis on selected text inside an embedded frame from another website, which Chrome does not let Clavis read when website access is off.

toolbarCommandExplain.description: Name of the keyboard shortcut (chrome://extensions/shortcuts) that shows the Clavis toolbar for the current selection and moves keyboard focus into it. Works with or without website access.

toolbarContextMenuTitle.description: Right-click menu item on selected text. Works on the current tab even if website access was not granted (FR-018).

toolbarSiteAccessPending.message: Waiting for your answer in Chrome's permission prompt…
toolbarSiteAccessPending.description: Status on the onboarding page while Chrome shows the website access permission prompt.

toolbarSiteAccessGranted.message: Website access is on. Clavis will show its toolbar when you select text on a page.
toolbarSiteAccessGranted.description: Status on the onboarding page after the user granted website access.

toolbarSiteAccessDenied.message: Website access stayed off. You can still right-click selected text and choose Explain with Clavis.
toolbarSiteAccessDenied.description: Status on the onboarding page after the user declined the Chrome permission prompt.

toolbarSiteAccessSkipped.message: Okay. Right-click selected text and choose Explain with Clavis, or turn on website access later in Settings.
toolbarSiteAccessSkipped.description: Status on the onboarding page after the user chose not to enable website access now.

toolbarSiteAccessError.message: Chrome could not show the permission prompt. Try again.
toolbarSiteAccessError.description: Status on the onboarding page when requesting website access failed unexpectedly.

onboardingTitle.description: Main heading and tab title of the onboarding page shown once after installation.

optionsTitle.description: Main heading and tab title of the settings page.

readerTitle.description: Main heading and tab title of the PDF reader page.

readerOpen.description: Reader toolbar button that opens a file picker for a local PDF.

readerClose.description: Reader toolbar button that closes the current PDF and frees its memory.

readerEmptyTitle.description: Heading of the reader's empty state, shown before any PDF is open.

readerEmptyChoose.description: Large button in the reader's empty state that opens the file picker (the toolbar's Open PDF button does the same).

readerEmptyBody.message: Select a word or a sentence in the PDF to hear it read aloud or get an explanation, the same way as on a web page. Listening never sends anything. Explain sends only the text you selected and a little of the text around it.
readerEmptyBody.description: Reader empty-state paragraph that says what the reader is for and what leaves the device.

readerEmptyChrome.message: Chrome's built-in PDF viewer can't show Clavis. If a PDF opened there, download it and open it here, or drag the file onto this page.
readerEmptyChrome.description: Reader empty-state note explaining why PDFs must be opened in the Clavis reader rather than Chrome's own viewer.

readerShortcutsHint.message: Keyboard: N and P (or J and K) change page, + and − zoom, PageUp and PageDown scroll, Ctrl+F finds text.
readerShortcutsHint.description: Reader empty-state line listing the keyboard shortcuts. Keep the key names as written.

readerDocTitle.description: Browser tab title while a PDF is open. $FILE$ is the file name.

readerGroupPages.description: Accessible name of the group of page navigation controls in the reader toolbar.

readerGroupZoom.description: Accessible name of the group of zoom controls in the reader toolbar.

readerOpened.description: Screen-reader announcement when a PDF has finished opening. $FILE$ is the file name, $PAGES$ the number of pages.

readerClosedLive.description: Screen-reader announcement when the PDF was closed.

readerPageLive.description: Screen-reader announcement when the visible page changes. $PAGE$ is the page number, $TOTAL$ the number of pages.

readerZoomLive.description: Screen-reader announcement when the zoom level changes. $PERCENT$ is a whole number.

readerEmptyHint.message: Choose a PDF from this computer, or drop one anywhere on this page. The file stays on your device.
readerEmptyHint.description: Reader empty-state line under the Open PDF button; it also names the drag-and-drop target.

readerDropActive.message: Drop the PDF to open it
readerDropActive.description: Reader drop zone text while a file is being dragged over the page.

readerLoading.description: Reader status while a PDF is loading. $FILE$ is the file name.

readerViewerLabel.description: Accessible name of the scrolling region that holds the PDF pages.

readerPageLabel.description: Accessible name of the current-page number input in the reader toolbar.

readerPageOf.description: Shown after the page number input. $TOTAL$ is the number of pages in the PDF.

readerPrevPage.description: Accessible name of the reader toolbar button that goes to the previous page.

readerNextPage.description: Accessible name of the reader toolbar button that goes to the next page.

readerZoomOut.description: Accessible name of the reader toolbar button that makes pages smaller.

readerZoomIn.description: Accessible name of the reader toolbar button that makes pages larger.

readerZoomLabel.description: Accessible name of the reader zoom drop-down.

readerFitWidth.description: Reader zoom option and button that scales pages to the width of the window.

readerZoomPercent.description: A zoom level as a percentage, for example 125%. $PERCENT$ is a whole number.

readerFindLabel.description: Accessible name and placeholder of the reader's find-in-document text box.

readerFindPrev.description: Accessible name of the button that jumps to the previous find result.

readerFindNext.description: Accessible name of the button that jumps to the next find result.

readerFindCount.description: Find progress, for example 2 of 5. $CURRENT$ is the highlighted match, $TOTAL$ the number of matches.

readerFindPending.description: Shown while find-in-document is still searching.

readerFindToggle.description: Reader toolbar button that shows or hides the find-in-document bar.

readerFindClose.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the find-in-document bar.

readerFindCase.description: Toggle in the find bar: when on, find only matches the exact capital and small letters typed.

readerErrorCorrupt.message: This PDF is damaged and can't be opened. Try another copy of the file.
readerErrorCorrupt.description: Reader error shown when the PDF structure is invalid, truncated or empty.

readerErrorPermission.message: Chrome couldn't read this file. Check that it still exists and that you can open it, then try again.
readerErrorPermission.description: Reader error shown when the browser is not allowed to read the chosen file.

readerErrorTooLarge.message: This PDF is larger than $MAX$ MB, which is the most Clavis can open. Try a smaller file.
readerErrorTooLarge.description: Reader error for files over the size limit. $MAX$ is the limit in megabytes.

readerErrorTooManyPages.message: This PDF has more than $MAX$ pages, which is the most Clavis can open. Try a shorter file.
readerErrorTooManyPages.description: Reader error for documents over the page-count limit. $MAX$ is the limit.

readerErrorUnsupported.message: Clavis can't read this file. Choose a different PDF.
readerErrorUnsupported.description: Reader error shown when the file is not a PDF or uses a feature the reader does not support.

readerErrorRender.message: Clavis couldn't start its PDF viewer or draw this document. Reload this page and try again. If it keeps happening, try a different PDF.
readerErrorRender.description: Reader error shown when the viewer itself fails (not a problem with the chosen file).

readerRenderIssue.message: Some pages couldn't be drawn. The rest of the document still works.
readerRenderIssue.description: Reader notice shown while one or more pages failed to render.

readerAnnotationsLimited.message: Some links and notes on a page are not shown because the page has too many of them. The text is unaffected.
readerAnnotationsLimited.description: Reader notice shown when a PDF page has more annotations (links, notes, markup) than the reader draws.

readerChooseAnother.description: Button shown with a reader error that opens the file picker again.

readerImageOnly.message: This PDF appears image-only. Its pages are pictures without text, so text can't be selected. Text recognition (OCR) isn't available in this version.
readerImageOnly.description: Reader notice for scanned PDFs without a text layer (requirements section 7: PDF scanned only).

readerPasswordTitle.description: Heading of the prompt shown when a PDF is encrypted.

readerPasswordPrompt.message: $FILE$ is protected. Enter its password to open it.
readerPasswordPrompt.description: Explains the password prompt. $FILE$ is the file name.

readerPasswordLabel.description: Accessible name of the PDF password input.

readerPasswordIncorrect.message: That password isn't correct. Try again.
readerPasswordIncorrect.description: Shown after a wrong PDF password was entered.

readerPasswordSubmit.description: Button that submits the PDF password.

readerPasswordCancel.description: Button that dismisses the PDF password prompt without opening the file.

readerLinkConfirmTitle.description: Heading of the confirmation shown before an external link in a PDF opens.

readerLinkConfirmBody.message: This PDF links to $URL$. Only open links you trust.
readerLinkConfirmBody.description: Asks the user to confirm opening an external link. $URL$ is the link address.

readerLinkOpen.description: Button that confirms opening an external link from a PDF in a new tab.

readerLinkCancel.description: Button that cancels opening an external link from a PDF.

uiBack.description: Button that goes to the previous step of the setup wizard.

uiNext.description: Button that goes to the next step of the setup wizard.

uiCancel.description: Button that dismisses a confirmation without doing anything.

uiRetry.description: Button that repeats the action that just failed.

uiLoading.description: Shown while a settings page section is loading its data.

uiSaving.description: Status shown while a change is being saved.

uiSaved.description: Confirmation announced after a setting was saved.

uiDismissNotification.description: Accessible name of the close button on a temporary Settings notification.

uiOpenSettings.description: Button that opens the Clavis settings page.

uiUpdateKey.description: Button that opens the settings page so the user can replace a Groq key that does not work.

uiConnectGroq.description: Button that opens the settings page so the user can paste a Groq key. Groq is the AI provider name.

uiOpensInNewTab.description: Visually hidden suffix added to the accessible name of a link that opens a new browser tab.

errInvalidApiKey.message: Groq didn't accept your key. Check that you copied the whole key, or create a new one on the Groq keys page.
errInvalidApiKey.description: Error shown when Groq rejects the API key (HTTP 401). Groq is the AI provider name.

errNetwork.message: Clavis can't reach Groq. Check your internet connection and try again.
errNetwork.description: Error shown when the network request to Groq failed.

errTimeout.message: Groq took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
errTimeout.description: Error shown when a request to Groq timed out.

errRateLimited.message: Groq's rate limit was reached. Wait a moment, then try again.
errRateLimited.description: Error shown when Groq answers that too many requests were made (HTTP 429).

errRateLimitedSeconds.message: Groq's rate limit was reached. Try again in about $SECONDS$ seconds.
errRateLimitedSeconds.description: Error shown for a Groq rate limit when Groq says how long to wait. $SECONDS$ is a whole number of seconds.

errRateLimitedLocal.message: Too many requests from Clavis. Wait a moment, then try again.
errRateLimitedLocal.description: Error shown when Clavis's own per-tab request limit was reached (not a Groq limit). Nothing was sent to Groq.

errRateLimitedLocalSeconds.message: Too many requests from Clavis. Try again in about $SECONDS$ seconds.
errRateLimitedLocalSeconds.description: Error shown when Clavis's own per-tab request limit was reached, with the wait. $SECONDS$ is a whole number of seconds.

errStorage.message: Chrome's protected extension storage isn't available, so Clavis can't save or use your key. Restart Chrome and try again.
errStorage.description: Error shown when the browser could not restrict extension storage to trusted pages, so key actions are refused.

errInvalidRequest.message: Clavis couldn't process that request. Reload this page and try again.
errInvalidRequest.description: Error shown when the background part of the extension rejected a request as malformed or from an unexpected page.

errSetupRequired.message: Connect your Groq key to use Explain.
errSetupRequired.description: Error shown when Explain is used before a Groq key is connected.

errModelUnavailable.message: The chosen model isn't available. Open settings and choose another model.
errModelUnavailable.description: Error shown when the selected Groq model cannot be used with the key.

errPermission.message: Chrome didn't allow that. Open settings to check Clavis's permissions.
errPermission.description: Error shown when the browser refused a permission-gated action.

errNoResponse.message: Clavis isn't responding. Wait a few seconds and try again. If it keeps happening, reload the extension on the chrome://extensions page.
errNoResponse.description: Error shown when the extension background did not answer, for example while it restarts.

errInvalidResponse.message: Clavis couldn't read the answer. Try again.
errInvalidResponse.description: Error shown when the answer from the provider or the extension background had an unexpected shape.

errSelectionTooLong.message: That selection is too long. Select a shorter piece of text.
errSelectionTooLong.description: Error shown when the selected text is over the allowed length.

errUnsupportedSite.message: Clavis can't work on this kind of page.
errUnsupportedSite.description: Error shown when the current page does not allow the extension.

errCancelled.description: Status shown when a request was cancelled before it finished.

errGeneric.description: Fallback error shown when no more specific message applies.

onbProgressLabel.description: Accessible name of the list that shows the steps of the setup wizard.

onbStepOf.description: Position in the setup wizard, for example Step 2 of 7.

onbStepPurpose.description: Short name of setup step 1, shown in the progress list.

onbStepDisclosure.description: Short name of the setup step that explains what data is sent, shown in the progress list.

onbStepAccess.description: Short name of the setup step about website access, shown in the progress list.

onbStepConnect.description: Short name of the setup step where the user pastes the Groq key, shown in the progress list.

onbStepPrefs.description: Short name of the setup step for language and reading preferences, shown in the progress list.

onbStepPractice.description: Short name of the setup step that opens the practice page, shown in the progress list.

onbStepDone.description: Short name of the last setup step, shown in the progress list.

onbStepCurrent.description: Visually hidden text that marks the current step in the setup progress list.

onbStepComplete.description: Visually hidden text that marks a finished step in the setup progress list.

onbPurposeTitle.message: Understand and pronounce what you read
onbPurposeTitle.description: Heading of the first setup step, which explains what Clavis does.

onbPurposeIntro.message: Clavis helps you with words and sentences you select on webpages and in PDF files you open on this computer.
onbPurposeIntro.description: Intro paragraph of the first setup step.

onbPurposeListen.message: Listen reads your selection aloud, trying an on-device voice first and an online voice if needed.
onbPurposeListen.description: Bullet in the first setup step. Listen is the name of a toolbar button.

onbPurposeExplain.message: Explain tells you what it means in context, using Groq's AI with your own Groq key.
onbPurposeExplain.description: Bullet in the first setup step. Explain is the name of a toolbar button. Groq is the AI provider name.

onbPurposeTime.message: Setup takes a few minutes. You can skip the Groq key for now and still use Listen and the PDF reader.
onbPurposeTime.description: Closing paragraph of the first setup step.

onbDisclosureAccepted.message: You've already confirmed this. You can continue.
onbDisclosureAccepted.description: Shown on the data disclosure step when the user already clicked I understand earlier, for example when running the tutorial again.

onbDisclosureSaved.description: Status announced after the user clicked I understand.

onbAccessAlternative.message: Without website access you can still use Clavis: select text, right-click it and choose Explain with Clavis. You can also press Alt+Shift+E after selecting text, or click the Clavis icon in Chrome and choose Explain on this page. If you don't see the icon, open Chrome's Extensions menu (the puzzle-piece icon) and pin Clavis.
onbAccessAlternative.description: Explains the right-click, keyboard shortcut and toolbar icon alternatives to website access. Alt+Shift+E is the default shortcut.

onbAccessLater.message: You can change this at any time in Settings.
onbAccessLater.description: Reminder under the website access choice.

onbGetKeyIntro.message: Explain uses a key from your Groq account. Need one?
onbGetKeyIntro.description: Short introduction to getting a Groq key on the connection step.

onbGetKeyStep1.message: Sign in or create an account.
onbGetKeyStep1.description: First instruction beside the Groq keys page link on the connection step.

onbGetKeyStep2.message: Create an API key there, copy it, and paste it below.
onbGetKeyStep2.description: Second instruction on the connection step.

onbGetKeyLink.description: Link text that opens https://console.groq.com/keys in a new tab.

onbKeyStepsSummary.description: Expands short numbered instructions on the onboarding connection step.

onbSkipKey.description: Button that skips connecting Groq during setup.

onbSkipKeyHint.message: You can skip this. Listen and the PDF reader work without a key, and Explain will ask you to connect Groq when you first use it.
onbSkipKeyHint.description: Explains what happens when the user skips connecting Groq.

onbConnectTitle.description: Heading of the setup step where the user pastes the Groq key.

onbConnectContinue.description: Button that continues after a key was connected.

onbPrefsTitle.description: Heading of the setup step for language, reading level, speed and toolbar behavior.

onbPrefsIntro.message: These save as you change them. You can change them later in Settings.
onbPrefsIntro.description: Intro paragraph of the preferences step.

onbPracticeTitle.message: Try it on a practice page
onbPracticeTitle.description: Heading of the setup step that opens the practice page.

onbPracticeBody.message: Open a short article made for practice. Select a word or a sentence, then choose Listen or Explain in the toolbar. It works on your computer without visiting any website.
onbPracticeBody.description: Body of the practice step. Listen and Explain are names of toolbar buttons.

onbPracticeNoKey.message: You haven't connected Groq, so Explain will show you how to connect it. Listen works now.
onbPracticeNoKey.description: Note on the practice step when no Groq key is connected.

onbPracticeOpen.description: Link text that opens the practice page in a new tab.

onbDoneTitle.description: Heading of the last setup step.

onbDoneBody.message: Select text on any page and use the Clavis toolbar. Settings and the PDF reader are always one click away from the Clavis icon. If you don't see the icon, open Chrome's Extensions menu (the puzzle-piece icon) and pin Clavis.
onbDoneBody.description: Body of the last setup step.

onbDoneNoKey.message: You haven't connected Groq yet, so Explain won't work until you do. Listen and the PDF reader work now.
onbDoneNoKey.description: Warning on the last setup step when no Groq key is connected.

onbDoneSaved.message: Setup is complete. You can close this tab.
onbDoneSaved.description: Status shown after setup was completed.

onbSummaryHeading.description: Heading of the setup summary on the last step.

onbSummaryGroq.description: Label in the setup summary for the Groq connection. Groq is the AI provider name.

onbSummaryAccess.description: Label in the setup summary for website access.

onbSummaryConnected.description: Value in the setup summary when a Groq key is connected.

onbSummaryNotConnected.description: Value in the setup summary when no Groq key is connected.

onbSummaryOn.description: Value in the setup summary when website access is on.

onbSummaryOff.description: Value in the setup summary when website access is off; the user can use the right-click menu instead.

keyTitle.description: Heading of the API key section in Settings. Groq is the AI provider name.

keyInputLabel.description: Label of the masked text box where the user pastes the Groq key.

keyInputHint.message: Paste the key here. Groq keys usually start with gsk_.
keyInputHint.description: Hint under the Groq key text box.

keyPrefixHint.message: This doesn't start with gsk_, which Groq keys usually do. Check that you copied the whole key.
keyPrefixHint.description: Soft warning when the pasted key does not look like a Groq key. It does not block connecting.

keyShow.description: Button that reveals the key in its text box.

keyHide.description: Button that masks the key in its text box.

keyStorageLegend.message: Where should Clavis keep your key?
keyStorageLegend.description: Legend of the radio group that chooses between keeping the key on this device or only for this session.

keyConnect.description: Button that saves the pasted key and checks it with Groq.

keyConnecting.description: Status while the key is being saved and checked.

keyEmptyError.description: Error shown when Connect is pressed with an empty key box.

keyFormatError.message: That doesn't look like a key. A key has no spaces or line breaks and is under 512 characters.
keyFormatError.description: Error shown when the pasted text cannot be a key.

keyResultValid.message: Connected. Groq accepted your key ending in $LAST4$.
keyResultValid.description: Success message after the key was verified. $LAST4$ is the last four characters of the key.

keyResultInvalid.message: Groq didn't accept this key. Check that you copied the whole key, or create a new one on the Groq keys page.
keyResultInvalid.description: Message after Groq rejected the key.

keyResultUnverified.message: Your key is saved, but the check could not confirm access. Choose Test connection to retry. Lookup will try the key when you use it.
keyResultUnverified.description: Message when Groq access could not be confirmed, including permission and network failures.

keyResultChecking.description: Status while Clavis verifies the key with Groq.

keyModelsCount.description: Shown after a key check. $COUNT$ is the number of models.

keyTest.description: Button that asks Groq whether the saved key works.

keyChange.description: Button that shows the form for replacing the saved key.

keyRemove.description: Button that deletes the saved key.

keyRemoveTitle.description: Heading of the confirmation shown before the key is deleted.

keyRemoveBody.message: Clavis will delete the key from this browser and stop using Groq until you connect a new key. Your preferences stay.
keyRemoveBody.description: Body of the confirmation shown before the key is deleted.

keyRemoved.description: Status after the key was deleted.

keyNone.description: Status in Settings when there is no saved key.

keyGetLink.description: Link to Groq's key page when no key is connected.

keyNoneHint.message: Explain needs a key. Listen and the PDF reader work without one.
keyNoneHint.description: Hint when there is no saved key.

keyFactStatus.description: Label of the key status row in Settings.

keyFactKey.description: Label of the row that shows the last four characters of the saved key.

keyFactStorage.description: Label of the row that shows where the key is kept.

keyFactChecked.description: Label of the row that shows when the key was last verified.

keyFactResponse.description: Label for the HTTP response code or missing response from the latest failed key check.

keyHttpStatus.description: Safe numeric HTTP response from the latest failed key check; $STATUS$ is a three-digit status code.

keyNoHttpResponse.description: The latest key check failed before a Groq HTTP response arrived.

keyHttpModelOrg.message: Groq reports that your organization blocks this model. Ask the organization owner to review model limits.
keyHttpModelOrg.description: Fixed help for a documented organization-level model permission code.

keyHttpModelProject.message: Groq reports that your project blocks this model. Ask a project admin to review model limits.
keyHttpModelProject.description: Fixed help for a documented project-level model permission code.

keyHttpModelPermission.message: Groq reports blocked model access. Review model permissions for the key's project.
keyHttpModelPermission.description: Fixed help for a documented generic model permission code.

keyHttpPermissionRestriction.message: Groq reports a permission restriction but did not identify the setting. Check access for the key's project and organization.
keyHttpPermissionRestriction.description: Fixed help for a Groq permissions_error type without a more specific allowlisted code.

keyHttpRegionBlock.message: A Cloudflare response indicates a region block. Contact Groq support if this is unexpected.
keyHttpRegionBlock.description: Fixed help for a 403 Cloudflare error 1009 response.

keyHttpEdgeBlock.message: A Cloudflare response indicates a security or browser/IP block. Contact Groq support with the time of this check.
keyHttpEdgeBlock.description: Fixed help for a 403 Cloudflare 1010 or 1020 response.

keyHttpUnknown.message: Clavis cannot determine why this request was denied. Your key remains saved. Check Groq API access for its project or contact Groq support.
keyHttpUnknown.description: Fixed help when a 403 response does not match a known safe marker; does not claim a cause.

keyProbeForbidden.message: A request without an API key was also denied (HTTP 403). This refusal is independent of the saved key; browser, network, or upstream access policy needs checking.
keyProbeForbidden.description: Safe comparison conclusion when an unauthenticated request also receives HTTP 403.

keyProbeAuthRequired.message: Groq returned HTTP 401 without a key as expected, but HTTP 403 with the saved key. Authentication, account, or request policy may differ; this does not prove the key is invalid.
keyProbeAuthRequired.description: Safe comparison conclusion when the unauthenticated request gets HTTP 401.

keyProbeUnreachable.message: The comparison request got no HTTP response. The comparison is inconclusive.
keyProbeUnreachable.description: Safe comparison conclusion when the unauthenticated request has no HTTP response.

keyProbeOtherResponse.message: The comparison response was unexpected. The comparison is inconclusive.
keyProbeOtherResponse.description: Safe comparison conclusion when the unauthenticated request gets a response other than HTTP 401 or 403.

keyCopyDiagnostics.description: Copies only fixed connection diagnostic fields without a key, last four characters, or provider text.

keyDiagnosticsCopied.description: Confirmation after copying safe key-connection diagnostics.

keyDiagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Clipboard unavailable. You can copy the status shown above.
keyDiagnosticsCopyFailed.description: Feedback when safe key-connection diagnostics could not be copied.

keyDiagnosticsReport.message:
Clavis connection diagnostics
HTTP: $STATUS$
Unauthenticated comparison: $PROBE$
403 category: $REASON$
keyDiagnosticsReport.description: Fixed clipboard report. Contains only numeric HTTP status and allowlisted categories, never key or provider text.

cardErrHttpTitle.description: Heading for an explanation failure with an actual HTTP response from Groq or its edge.

cardErrHttpServer.message: The service could not complete the request. Try again shortly.
cardErrHttpServer.description: Guidance for a Groq HTTP 5xx response; distinct from a missing network response.

cardErrHttpOther.message: The request did not complete. Try again, or check Groq access if it continues.
cardErrHttpOther.description: Neutral guidance for an HTTP response mapped to NETWORK_ERROR that is neither 403 nor a 5xx.

keyEnding.description: Shows only the last four characters of the saved key. $LAST4$ is four characters.

keyStatusValid.description: Key status: Groq accepted the key.

keyStatusInvalid.description: Key status: Groq rejected the key.

keyStatusUnverified.description: Key status: access could not be confirmed; the cause may be permissions, network, or another failure.

keyStatusNever.description: Key status: the key is saved and has never been checked.

keyStorageLocalShort.message: On this device until you remove it
keyStorageLocalShort.description: Shows that the key is kept in persistent extension storage.

keyStorageSessionShort.message: Only for this session (cleared when Chrome closes)
keyStorageSessionShort.description: Shows that the key is kept only in memory for this browser session.

keyNeverChecked.description: Shown as the last-checked time when the key was never verified.

keyNotEncrypted.message: Clavis does not encrypt your key. A key kept on this device sits in Chrome's extension storage, where anyone with access to your Chrome profile could find it. Clavis does not use your operating system's password vault.
keyNotEncrypted.description: Statement that key storage is not encrypted and is not an operating system secret vault (FR-071). Must not claim encryption.

keyConnectedLive.description: Short status announced after a key check succeeded.

prefsTitle.description: Heading of the preferences section in Settings.

prefLanguage.description: Label of the drop-down that chooses the language explanations are written in.

prefLanguageHint.message: Explanations are written in this language.
prefLanguageHint.description: Hint under the explanation language drop-down.

prefTranslationLanguage.description: Label of the drop-down for the Translate tab's target language.

prefTranslationLanguageHint.message: When you open Translate from a selection, Clavis translates into this language.
prefTranslationLanguageHint.description: Hint under the translation language drop-down.

prefVoiceLanguage.description: Label of the drop-down that chooses the language used to pick a voice for Listen.

prefVoiceLanguageAuto.description: Option that lets Clavis pick the voice language from the selected text.

prefVoiceLanguageHint.message: Used to choose a voice for Listen.
prefVoiceLanguageHint.description: Hint under the voice language drop-down. Listen is the name of a toolbar button.

prefLevel.description: Legend of the radio group that chooses how simple explanations are.

prefLevelSimple.message: Simple: short words and plain sentences

prefSpeed.description: Legend of the radio group that chooses how fast Listen reads.

prefSpeedCustom.description: Shown when the saved playback speed is neither Normal nor Slow. $RATE$ is a number such as 1.5.

prefTooltip.description: Legend of the radio group that chooses automatic or on-demand toolbar.

prefTooltipAutomatic.message: Automatically when I select text (needs website access)

prefTooltipOnDemand.message: Only when I ask: right-click, the keyboard shortcut or the Clavis icon

prefReset.description: Button that restores all preferences to their default values.

prefResetDone.message: Preferences were reset to their defaults.

prefResetHint.message: Resets language, reading level, speed, toolbar behavior and model choice.
prefResetHint.description: Hint next to the reset button.

modelTitle.description: Heading of the model section in Settings.

modelAuto.description: Model option that lets Clavis use its default model.

modelChoose.description: Placeholder option when the saved model is not available and the user must pick another.

modelMissing.message: The model you chose, $MODEL$, isn't available to your key right now. Choose another model below. Clavis won't switch models for you.
modelMissing.description: Warning when the saved model is missing from the list Groq returned. $MODEL$ is a model id.

modelListNoKey.message: Connect a Groq key to see the models you can use. Until then Clavis uses its recommended model.
modelListNoKey.description: Note under the model drop-down when no key is saved.

modelListEmpty.message: The list of models appears after Clavis checks your key with Groq. Until then Clavis uses its recommended model.
modelListEmpty.description: Note under the model drop-down when the key was never verified.

modelListUnverified.message: Clavis couldn't check your key with Groq, so this list may be out of date.
modelListUnverified.description: Note under the model drop-down when the last key check failed because of the network.

modelPlanNote.message: Which models you can use and their limits depend on your Groq plan. Clavis never switches models on its own.

siteTitle.description: Heading of the website access section in Settings.

siteStatusOn.message: Website access is on. Clavis shows its toolbar when you select text on websites.
siteStatusOn.description: Settings status when site access is granted and active.

siteStatusNotStarted.message: Website access is on, but Clavis hasn't started on your open pages yet. Reload a page to use the toolbar there.
siteStatusNotStarted.description: Settings status when site access is granted but the page script is not registered yet.

siteStatusOff.message: Website access is off. Select text, right-click and choose Explain with Clavis, or click the Clavis icon and choose Explain on this page.
siteStatusOff.description: Settings status when site access is not granted.

siteRevokeHelp.message: To turn it off in Chrome, open Clavis on the chrome://extensions page, choose Details, and change Site access. You can also use the button below.
siteRevokeHelp.description: Explains how to revoke website access in Chrome.

siteRevoke.description: Button that removes the optional website access.

siteRevoked.description: Status after website access was removed.

siteOpenExtensions.message: Open Clavis in Chrome's extensions page
siteOpenExtensions.description: Button that opens Clavis's details on the chrome://extensions page.

siteDisabledTitle.description: Heading of the per-site disable list in Settings.

siteDisabledIntro.message: Clavis won't show its toolbar automatically on these websites.

siteDisabledLabel.description: Label of the text box for adding a website to the disable list.

siteDisabledHint.message: For example: example.com. Only that exact address is matched: example.com does not cover www.example.com, so add each address you need.
siteDisabledHint.description: Hint under the website address text box.

siteDisabledAdd.description: Button that adds a website to the disable list.

siteDisabledListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of disabled websites.

siteDisabledRemove.description: Accessible name of the button that removes one website from the list. $SITE$ is a host name.

siteDisabledRemoveShort.description: Visible text of the button that removes one website from the list.

siteDisabledEmpty.description: Shown when the disable list is empty.

siteDisabledErrEmpty.description: Error shown when adding an empty website address.

siteDisabledErrInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a website address. Use a name such as example.com.
siteDisabledErrInvalid.description: Error shown when the website address is not valid.

siteDisabledErrDuplicate.description: Error shown when the website is already listed. $SITE$ is a host name.

siteDisabledErrLimit.message: The list is full. Remove a website before adding another.
siteDisabledErrLimit.description: Error shown when the disable list reached its maximum size.

siteDisabledAdded.description: Status after adding a website to the list. $SITE$ is a host name.

siteDisabledRemoved.description: Status after removing a website from the list. $SITE$ is a host name.

privacyTitle.description: Heading of the privacy section in Settings.

privacyIntro.message: This is what Clavis does with your reading, and when.
privacyIntro.description: Intro line of the privacy section in Settings.

privacyPolicyLink.description: Link text to the Clavis privacy policy.

clearTitle.description: Heading of the clear-all-data block in Settings.

clearBody.message: Removes your Groq key, preferences, setup progress and website list from this browser. It does not remove website access that Chrome granted; use Remove website access for that.
clearBody.description: Explains what Clear all data removes.

clearButton.description: Button that starts clearing all Clavis data.

clearConfirmTitle.description: Heading of the confirmation shown before clearing all data.

clearConfirmBody.message: This removes your key, preferences and setup progress from this browser. It can't be undone.
clearConfirmBody.description: Body of the confirmation shown before clearing all data.

clearConfirm.description: Button that confirms clearing all data.

clearDone.message: All Clavis data was removed from this browser.
clearDone.description: Status after all data was cleared.

helpTitle.description: Heading of the help section in Settings.

helpTutorial.description: Link that opens the first-run setup wizard again.

helpPractice.description: Link that opens the practice page in a new tab.

helpPdf.description: Link that opens the PDF reader in a new tab.

helpShortcut.message: Keyboard: select text, then press Alt+Shift+E to open the Clavis toolbar. You can change the shortcut on the chrome://extensions/shortcuts page.
helpShortcut.description: Explains the keyboard shortcut. Alt+Shift+E is the default.

pdfHelpTitle.description: Heading of the PDF help in Settings > Help.

pdfHelpWhy.message: Chrome shows PDFs in its own built-in viewer. That viewer is a separate page that extensions can't add a toolbar to, so Listen and Explain can't appear there. Clavis never takes over or changes how Chrome opens PDFs.
pdfHelpWhy.description: PDF help: why the toolbar does not appear in Chrome's own PDF viewer (FR-056).

pdfHelpIntro.message: To use Clavis on a PDF, open it in the Clavis PDF reader:
pdfHelpIntro.description: PDF help: introduces the numbered steps.

pdfHelpStep1.message: Click the Clavis icon and choose Open PDF reader, or use the link below. If you don't see the icon, open Chrome's Extensions menu (the puzzle-piece icon) and pin Clavis.
pdfHelpStep1.description: PDF help step 1. Open PDF reader is the popup button's name.

pdfHelpStep2.message: Choose the PDF from your computer, or drag the file onto the reader page.

pdfHelpStep3.message: Select a word or a sentence, then use Listen or Explain, just as on a web page.
pdfHelpStep3.description: PDF help step 3. Listen and Explain are toolbar button names.

pdfHelpWebPdf.message: If the PDF is on a website, save it to your computer first (use the download button in Chrome's viewer), then open the saved file. The reader opens files from your computer only, not web addresses.
pdfHelpWebPdf.description: PDF help: remote PDFs are not supported in this version (D-03).

pdfHelpLimitsTitle.description: Heading of the list of PDF limitations in Settings > Help.

pdfHelpLimitScan.message: Scanned PDFs made of page pictures have no text to select. Clavis has no text recognition (OCR), so it can't read them.

pdfHelpLimitPassword.message: Password-protected PDFs ask for their password when you open them.
pdfHelpLimitPassword.description: PDF limitation: encrypted PDFs are supported through a password prompt.

pdfHelpLimitXfa.message: Forms that use only XFA, an older PDF form format, aren't supported.

siteHelpTitle.description: Heading of the help for people who did not allow website access (FR-018). Also the label of the popup's expandable help.

siteHelpIntro.message: With website access off, the toolbar doesn't appear by itself when you select text. You can still use Clavis on the page you're reading, one page at a time:
siteHelpIntro.description: Site access help: introduces the three ways to use Clavis without website access.

siteHelpContextMenu.message: Select text, right-click it and choose Explain with Clavis.
siteHelpContextMenu.description: Site access help: the context menu path. Explain with Clavis is the context menu item's name.

siteHelpIcon.message: Select text, click the Clavis icon and choose Explain on this page. If you don't see the icon, open Chrome's Extensions menu (the puzzle-piece icon) and pin Clavis.
siteHelpIcon.description: Site access help: the toolbar icon path. Explain on this page is the popup button's name.

siteHelpShortcut.message: Select text and press Alt+Shift+E. You can change the shortcut on the chrome://extensions/shortcuts page.
siteHelpShortcut.description: Site access help: the keyboard shortcut path. Alt+Shift+E is the default.

siteHelpTurnOnTitle.description: Heading above the steps that turn on automatic mode.

siteHelpTurnOn.message: Choose Enable on websites under Website access in Settings. Or open the chrome://extensions page, choose Details for Clavis and set Site access to On all sites.
siteHelpTurnOn.description: Site access help: two ways to turn on website access. Enable on websites is a button name; Details and Site access are Chrome's own labels.

siteHelpToolbarSetting.message: Also check that When to show the toolbar, under Preferences, is set to Automatically. If it is set to Only when I ask, the toolbar stays hidden even with website access on.
siteHelpToolbarSetting.description: Site access help: the preference that also controls whether the toolbar appears by itself.

siteHelpOpenSettings.description: Popup button that opens Settings at the Website access section.

helpVoicesTitle.description: Heading of the voice limitations in Settings > Help.

helpVoicesBody.message: Listen uses the voices your device reports, so available languages and accents depend on your system. Automatic tries a matching on-device voice first, then a matching online voice if no local voice is available or can start. Online voices send the selected text to their provider.
helpVoicesBody.description: Help: truthful voice limitations (D-22). Voice settings is the name of a Settings section.

popupPdfTitle.message: This tab looks like a PDF
popupPdfTitle.description: Popup notice heading shown when the current tab's address ends in .pdf.

popupPdfBody.message: Clavis can't add its toolbar to Chrome's built-in PDF viewer. Save the PDF to your computer, then open it in the Clavis PDF reader.
popupPdfBody.description: Popup notice body for a PDF tab. Explains the supported path (D-03, FR-056).

popupPdfHelp.message: How to read PDFs with Clavis
popupPdfHelp.description: Popup link that opens the PDF help in Settings.

popupDisclosureBody.message: Before Explain can send text to Groq, Clavis needs you to read what it sends.
popupDisclosureBody.description: Popup notice shown when a key exists but the data notice was never accepted. The button opens the setup tutorial.

readerEmptyHelp.message: Why doesn't Clavis work in Chrome's PDF viewer?
readerEmptyHelp.description: Link in the reader's empty state that opens the PDF help in Settings.

voiceLimits.message: Which voices and languages you can use depends on your operating system. Clavis lists only the voices your device reports and uses a voice only for a language it speaks. Automatic tries on-device voices first, then online if needed. A voice marked online sends the selected text to that voice's provider.
voiceLimits.description: Voice section: truthful limits (D-22, FR-024, FR-025).

voiceSummary.description: Voice section: how many voices the device reports. $LOCAL$ and $ONLINE$ are numbers.

voiceGroupDevice.description: Group label in the voice drop-down for voices that speak on this computer.

voiceGroupOnline.message: Online (sends the text to a service)
voiceGroupOnline.description: Group label in the voice drop-down for online voices (D-22).

optionsNavLabel.description: Accessible name of the navigation list that jumps between settings sections.

optionsGroupConnection.description: Settings navigation group for the Groq key and model.

optionsGroupPrivacyHelp.description: Settings navigation group for privacy controls and help.

optionsAutoSaveHint.description: Explains that Settings preference changes are saved as soon as a control changes.

popupGroqLabel.description: Label in the popup status for the Groq connection. Groq is the AI provider name.

popupGroqReady.description: Popup status: a Groq key is saved and usable.

popupGroqSetup.description: Popup status: no Groq key is saved.

popupGroqInvalid.description: Popup status: the saved key was rejected by Groq.

popupGroqDisclosure.description: Popup status: a key is saved but the data disclosure was not confirmed yet.

popupGroqStorage.description: Popup status: Chrome could not restrict extension storage, so key actions are refused.

popupGroqChecking.description: Popup status while the Groq state is loading.

popupGroqUnknown.description: Popup status when the Groq state could not be read.

popupSiteLabel.description: Label in the popup status for website access.

popupSiteOn.description: Popup status: website access is granted.

popupSiteOff.description: Popup status: website access is not granted.

popupSiteChecking.description: Popup status while website access is being read.

popupReviewSetup.description: Popup button that opens the setup wizard to confirm the data notice.

popupStatusLabel.description: Accessible name of the popup status list.

practiceTitle.description: Heading and tab title of the practice page.

practiceIntro.message: Try Clavis here. Select a word or sentence in the article, then choose Lookup or Speak in the toolbar that appears.
practiceIntro.description: Intro on the practice page. Lookup and Speak are toolbar actions.

practiceNoKey.message: No Groq key yet? Speak works without one. Lookup will show you how to connect Groq.

practiceTryTitle.description: Heading of the list of practice suggestions.

practiceTry1.message: Select the word bank in the first paragraph and choose Lookup. Then select bank in the last paragraph and compare the two answers.
practiceTry1.description: Practice suggestion. bank is a word to select in the article.

practiceTry2.message: Select the whole sentence She finally broke the ice. and choose Lookup. Is it about ice, or about something else?
practiceTry2.description: Practice suggestion. The quoted sentence appears in the article.

practiceTry3.message: Press Escape to close the toolbar.

practiceArticleLabel.description: Accessible name of the frame that contains the practice article.

practiceArticleP1.message: They sat on the bank of the river and watched the water slide by. A heron stood very still among the reeds.
practiceArticleP1.description: First paragraph of the practice article. Contains the word bank in its river meaning.

practiceArticleP2.message: Everyone was quiet at first. She finally broke the ice. Soon they were all laughing about the ducks.
practiceArticleP2.description: Second paragraph of the practice article. Contains the sentence She finally broke the ice. which must stay a separate sentence.

practiceArticleP3.message: Later they walked into town, where Sam stopped at the bank to pay a bill. The two words look the same, but a river bank and a money bank are different things.
practiceArticleP3.description: Third paragraph of the practice article. Contains the word bank in its money meaning.

practiceShowToolbar.message: Show the toolbar for my selection
practiceShowToolbar.description: Button that opens the toolbar for the text currently selected in the practice article, as a keyboard alternative.

practiceShowToolbarHint.message: Prefer the keyboard? Select text first, then use this button.
practiceShowToolbarHint.description: Hint next to the show toolbar button.

practiceNoSelection.message: Select some text in the article first.
practiceNoSelection.description: Shown when the show toolbar button was used without a selection.

practiceResultTitle.description: Heading of the panel that shows what Listen or Explain did.

practiceSelected.description: Label before the text that was selected for Listen or Explain. The selected text follows it in its own element, so right-to-left text keeps its direction.

settingsReloadNote.message: Changes to when the toolbar appears and to this list apply to pages you load afterwards. Reload pages that are already open.
settingsReloadNote.description: Note in Settings: toolbar behavior and per-site disable changes only affect pages loaded after the change.

keyRemoveGroqNote.message: Removing the key from Clavis does not cancel it at Groq. To delete it there too, open the Groq keys page.
keyRemoveGroqNote.description: Part of the confirmation before removing the key: the key stays valid at Groq until deleted there. Followed by a link.

keyRemoveGroqLink.description: Link text to https://console.groq.com/keys in the remove-key confirmation.

cardRegion.description: Accessible name of the explanation card. $TEXT$ is the selected text, shortened.

cardSpeakTranslation.description: Accessible label for the speaker beside translated text; uses saved speech preferences.

cardBack.description: Return to the previous cached explanation layer.

cardLookup.description: Explain selected model-written text in a new layer of the same card.

cardLookupOverLimit.message: That selection is too long to look up. Select a shorter part of the answer.
cardLookupOverLimit.description: Shown when selected model-written text exceeds the explanation character limit; no partial text is sent.

cardKindWord.description: Label in the explanation card header: the selection is a single word.

cardKindPhrase.description: Label in the explanation card header: the selection is a short phrase.

cardKindSentence.description: Label in the explanation card header: the selection is a sentence.

cardKindPassage.description: Label in the explanation card header: the selection is several sentences.

cardTabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the tab list in the explanation card.

cardTabCore.description: Tab in the explanation card: the main explanation (meaning, definition, examples).

cardTabRoots.description: Tab in the explanation card: origin and roots of a word (etymology).

cardTabRelated.description: Tab in the explanation card: synonyms and antonyms.

cardTabSimplify.description: Tab in the explanation card: the text rewritten in plain language.

cardTabGrammar.description: Tab in the explanation card: grammar breakdown. Hidden until the feature is switched on.

cardTabTranslate.description: Tab in the explanation card (and a section in the side panel): translation of the selection into the language the person chose for explanations.

cardLoading.description: Shown in the explanation card, and read out, while the main explanation is being fetched.

cardLoadingTab.description: Shown in an explanation card tab, and read out, while its content is being fetched. $TAB$ is the tab name.

cardReady.description: Read out when the main explanation has arrived.

cardTabReady.description: Read out when the content of an explanation card tab has arrived. $TAB$ is the tab name.

cardMeaning.description: Label of the contextual meaning in the explanation card: what the text means where it was selected.

cardDefinition.description: Label of the plain definition in the explanation card.

cardExamples.description: Label of the example sentences in the explanation card. They are generated by the model, not quoted from a source.

cardNote.description: Label of a caveat or uncertainty note in the explanation card.

cardModel.description: Footer of the explanation card: which AI model wrote the answer. $MODEL$ is a model id.

cardEtymologyKnown.description: Note under a word's origin in the Roots tab when the model is confident.

cardEtymologyUncertain.message: The origin is uncertain. Treat this as a best guess.
cardEtymologyUncertain.description: Note under a word's origin in the Roots tab when the model is not sure.

cardSynonyms.description: Label of the synonyms list in the Related words tab.

cardAntonyms.description: Label of the antonyms list in the Related words tab.

cardNotApplicable.description: Shown in the Related words tab when there are no similar or opposite words that make sense.

cardSimplified.description: Label of the plain-language rewrite in the Simplify tab.

cardGrammar.description: Label of the grammar breakdown in the Grammar tab.

cardTranslation.description: Label of the translation in the Translate tab. $LANGUAGE$ is the language name.

cardLiteral.description: Label of the literal translation in the Translate tab.

cardCopy.description: Button in the explanation card: copy the visible answer as plain text.

cardCopied.description: Button label and announcement after the answer was copied.

cardCopyFailed.message: Copy isn't available on this page.
cardCopyFailed.description: Announcement when the browser would not let Clavis copy the answer, for example on a page without clipboard access.

cardErrConnectTitle.description: Heading of the explanation card error when Clavis cannot reach Groq (offline or timed out).

cardErrFormatTitle.description: Heading of the explanation card error when the answer could not be read.

cardErrRateTitle.description: Heading of the explanation card error when Groq's rate limit was reached.

cardActionConnect.description: Button in the explanation card error when no Groq key is set. Opens Settings at the key.

cardActionUpdateKey.description: Button in the explanation card error when Groq rejected the key. Opens Settings at the key.

cardActionChooseModel.description: Button in the explanation card error when the chosen model is unavailable. Opens Settings at the model.

cardRetryWait.description: Inactive retry button while a rate-limit wait is running. $SECONDS$ is the whole seconds left.

cardRetryReady.description: Read out when the rate-limit wait is over and Try again works.

cardSettingsFailed.message: Clavis couldn't open Settings. Open it from the Clavis icon in the toolbar.
cardSettingsFailed.description: Announcement when a card button could not open the Settings page.

cardLoadFailed.message: Clavis couldn't open the explanation card. Reload the page and try again.
cardLoadFailed.description: Shown in the toolbar when the explanation card script could not be loaded into the page.

explainPracticeResultEmpty.message: Choose Listen in the toolbar to see its result here. Explanations open in a card next to your selection.
explainPracticeResultEmpty.description: Placeholder in the practice page's result area. Explain shows its answer in a card at the selection; this area only reports Listen.

cardNotLoaded.message: This part wasn't loaded because its request was cancelled.
cardNotLoaded.description: Quiet note in an explanation card tab whose request was cancelled by something other than the user, for example a newer request from the same page. Followed by a Load button.

cardLoadAgain.description: Button in an explanation card tab that was not loaded: asks for it again.

speechNoVoiceLinuxHint.message: Install speech-dispatcher and a voice such as espeak-ng, then restart Chrome.
speechNoVoiceLinuxHint.description: Hint under the "no voice" message on Linux, where Chrome has no text-to-speech voice until a speech engine is installed (FR-023). speech-dispatcher and espeak-ng are software package names; do not translate them.

speechNoVoiceHint.message: Install a text-to-speech voice in your system settings, then restart Chrome.
speechNoVoiceHint.description: Hint under the "no voice" message on systems other than Linux (FR-023).

speechStarting.description: Screen reader announcement when Listen was pressed and audio has not started yet.

speechPlaying.description: Screen reader announcement when Listen audio started.

speechStopped.description: Screen reader announcement after the user pressed Stop on Listen.

speechStop.description: Label of the toolbar Listen button while audio is playing; pressing it stops the audio.

speechReplay.description: Label of the toolbar Listen button after the audio finished; pressing it reads the same text again.

speechSlow.description: Compact visible label of the toolbar speed toggle. When pressed, the next Speak playback uses 0.75× speed.

speechSpeedToggle.description: Stable accessible label of the toolbar speed toggle; its pressed state says whether slower playback is active.

speechRemoteNote.message: This voice sends the text to an online service.
speechRemoteNote.description: Small note shown once when the voice used by Listen synthesises speech online, so the text leaves the device (privacy).

speechPlaybackError.message: Playback stopped unexpectedly. Press Replay to try again.
speechPlaybackError.description: Message under the toolbar when the voice reported an error while reading aloud. Replay is the label of a toolbar button.

speechVoiceSettings.description: Button in the toolbar message about a missing voice; opens the Voice section of Settings.

speechTimedOut.message: The voice did not start in time. Press Listen to try again.
speechTimedOut.description: Message when Listen waited several seconds and no audio started (FR-023). Listen is the name of a toolbar button.

voiceTitle.description: Heading of the Voice section in Settings, where the user picks a voice for Listen and sees which voices exist on this device.

voiceIntro.message: Listen reads selected text aloud using on-device or online voices. Nothing is sent to Groq.
voiceIntro.description: Intro under the Voice heading in Settings. Listen is the name of a toolbar button.

voiceDevice.description: Heading above the voice counts in Settings.

voiceEmpty.message: No voices found on this device
voiceEmpty.description: Heading of the empty state in the Voice section when no text-to-speech voice exists.

voiceChooser.description: Label of the drop-down that chooses which voice Listen uses.

voiceAutomatic.description: Option in the voice drop-down: Clavis picks the best voice for the language.

voiceChooserHint.message: Automatic tries a matching on-device voice first, then an online voice if needed. Online voices send the text to their provider.

voiceLanguageFilter.description: Label of the drop-down that filters the voice list by language.

voiceAllLanguages.description: Option that shows voices of every language.

voiceOption.description: One voice in the drop-down. $NAME$ is the voice name, $LANG$ a language code such as en-US.

voiceOptionOnline.description: One voice in the drop-down that speaks through an online service. $NAME$ is the voice name, $LANG$ a language code.

voiceSavedMissing.description: Shown for a saved voice that is no longer on this device. $NAME$ is the voice name.

voiceTest.description: Button in Settings that reads a short sample with the chosen voice.

voiceTestSample.message: Hello, this is how Clavis sounds.
voiceTestSample.description: Sample sentence read aloud by the Test voice button.

voiceTestStarting.description: Status while the voice test has not started yet.

voiceTestPlaying.description: Status while the voice test is playing.

voiceTestDone.description: Status after the voice test finished.

listenDone.description: Status in the practice page's result area after Listen finished the selected text.

speechCancel.description: Label of the toolbar Listen button while audio is still starting; pressing it cancels the start.

voiceOnlineNote.message: This voice is an online service: when you press Listen, the selected text is sent to that service to be spoken.
voiceOnlineNote.description: Persistent privacy note under the voice drop-down in Settings when the chosen voice speaks through an online service. Listen is the name of a toolbar button.

voiceOnlineTag.description: Tag after the name of a voice that speaks through an online service, shown in the voice drop-down when the voice has no language code.

speechOnlineOnly.message: Only online voices are available for this language. To use one, choose it in Voice settings.
speechOnlineOnly.description: Compatibility message for an older speech engine reporting online-only voices. Automatic now tries matching online voices after on-device voices.

cardOpenPanel.description: Button in the explanation card: shows the whole explanation in Chrome's side panel, which has more room for long answers.

cardPanelOpened.description: Screen-reader announcement after the explanation was opened in Chrome's side panel.

cardPanelFailed.message: Clavis couldn't open the side panel. Try again.
cardPanelFailed.description: Announcement when the explanation card could not open Chrome's side panel.

cardLongHint.message: Long answer. The side panel has more room to read it.
cardLongHint.description: Hint in the explanation card when the answer is long; points to the Open in side panel button.

cardErrOfflineTitle.description: Heading of the explanation card error when the computer has no internet connection.

errOffline.message: Clavis can't reach Groq because this computer is offline. Reconnect, then try again.
errOffline.description: Message when an explain request failed and the browser reports that the computer is offline.

panelTitle.description: Title of the side panel page and its main heading.

panelSelectedLabel.description: Label above the selected text in the side panel.

panelSectionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of links to the sections (Core, Roots, ...) of the explanation in the side panel.

panelLoadMode.description: Button in the side panel that requests one more part of the explanation. $TAB$ is the name of the part, for example Roots.

panelNotLoaded.message: Not loaded yet. Loading it sends the selected text to Groq as one request.
panelNotLoaded.description: Text under a part of the explanation in the side panel that has not been requested yet. Groq is the AI provider.

panelNotLoadedShort.description: Added to a link name in the side panel's list of sections when that part has not been loaded yet.

panelCopySection.description: Accessible name of the Copy button of one section in the side panel. $TAB$ is the section name.

panelCopyAll.description: Button in the side panel that copies the selected text and every loaded part of the explanation as plain text.

panelUpdated.description: Screen-reader announcement when the side panel received a new explanation. $TEXT$ is the selected text, shortened.

panelEmptyTitle.description: Heading of the side panel when it has nothing to show.

panelEmptyBody.message: Select text on a page and choose Explain, then choose Open in side panel in the card. The explanation will appear here. If you saw one here before, Clavis was restarted or you moved to another page. Clavis doesn't keep your text, so select it again.
panelEmptyBody.description: Text of the empty side panel: how to fill it, and why a previous explanation may be gone.

panelDisclosure.message: Groq needs your confirmation before the first request. Confirm it in the explanation card on the page, then load this part again.
panelDisclosure.description: Message in the side panel when a request needs the one-time data disclosure confirmation, which only the card on the page can collect.

panelPdfPage.description: Line in the side panel header: the selection comes from this page of a PDF.

panelListenGroup.description: Accessible name of the group of Listen controls in the side panel.

panelAiNote.message: Written by AI, so it can be wrong. Check anything important.
panelAiNote.description: Short note in the side panel: the explanation is generated by an AI model.
